description: Agent Claims: submit a settlement offer and release with the claim valuation and the policy: the settlement with its reference, the claim number it cites, the currency, the figure it offers or releases for, each payee it names, each claim, coverage or matter the release gives up as it words them and the day of loss it names; the valuation with its claim number, the currency, the valuation figure, each coverage or part of the claim it covers and the day of loss; the policy with its number, each named insured and each loss payee, mortgagee or lienholder. The signed report gives the settlement, the valuation and the policy, the release read for catch-all wording such as any and all, all claims, known or unknown and future claims and each released matter read against the coverages the valuation covers, the figure against the valuation, and each payee against the named insureds and loss payees with every loss payee left off, and counts them, and names a divergent settlement: a release broader than the claim it settles, a figure unlike the valuation it follows or in another currency, and a payee who is not a named insured or loss payee on the policy; then a loss payee left off, another day of loss and another claim number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No release wording, no coverages on the valuation, no figure on either side or no payees leaves those points unverified. The release reads as a claim document against the claim it settles, matters by their words with plurals folded, payees as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, and the figure to the cent. Verdict claims_settlement_divergent, claims_settlement_partial, claims_settlement_unverified or claims_settlement_consistent. POST /api/claims-settlement-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.
